purpose: Qualify durable typed child recovery after actual loss of the original Root process and registry, including read-only scopes with no registered producer transaction.
required_composition: Frozen source-bound executables outside shared build targets; target release before native execution.
One new marker/inode/uid-owned PostgreSQL 16 cluster, actual migrations, max_prepared_transactions at least 256, private mTLS PKI and dedicated workload credentials.
Actual Auth/Friend owner stores, actual configured Root ledger and typed child settlers, actual Profile guarded producer and actual Concert local native child.
ProductReleaseBundle and PublicProfileReader public constructors using the selected source-bound release; no alternate positive constructor or legacy artwork.
Actual guarded Product/Delivery or Participant response path generates terminal root phase; never UPDATE phase or delivery receipt directly in SQL.

Terminate and reap the exact owned Root child process, then start a distinct child PID with the same configured durable instance and recovery-key ring. A new object in the same process is insufficient.
The replacement process uses an empty ScopeRegistry and the production durable-drain seam. A test-only direct ledger drain does not certify production startup integration.

ledger_phase_contract.ACTIVE: No terminal root proof. Process death, EOF of an internal RPC, original expiry and absent registry cannot authorize child settlement or an HTTP success acknowledgement.
ledger_phase_contract.SEALED: No more admissions, but no terminal root proof yet. Retain unknown children and owner exclusions; do not promote solely because a process exited.
ledger_phase_contract.ROOT_FINISHED: Actual prior root/callback drain and terminal path are durable. Eligible for typed child recovery independently of producer-transaction count. It is not a complete delivery receipt.
ledger_phase_contract.unexposed_no_work: The existing cap-never-published branch may finish only actual unexposed acquisition. It cannot be reused for a published response with protected work or child intents.
ledger_phase_contract.delivery_completed_at: Never infer from ROOT_FINISHED, all child acknowledgements, process absence or expiry. Preserve existing separate proof of both owners and all children; absent original registry still refuses content.

cases.name: finished_read_only_root_recovers_actual_children_after_process_restart
cases.setup: Acquire actual canonical owners; retain actual LocalPublic and ProfilePublic child guards through a real public projection. Assert zero rows in concert_product_owner_transactions for this exact scope.
cases.fault: After real terminal handling reaches durable ROOT_FINISHED, make actual child settlement temporarily unreachable, observe incomplete terminal result, then terminate and reap the original Root child.
observations: Before restart the pending encrypted intent row and actual prepared child exist, with immutable exact native/nonce/root binding.
After restart the old RootReadView and absent-registry content path fail closed.
Production drain discovers pending children without any ResolveTransaction call or producer-transaction registration.
With the actual child endpoint restored, real guarded recovery aborts the matching prepared child and records only the corresponding durable child acknowledgement.
Repeated drain is idempotent; no completed intent, identity, key identifier or root binding changes.

cases.name: lost_child_acquire_reply_recovers_without_a_live_child_handle
cases.setup: Durably register the actual pre-dispatch ProfilePublic intent, dispatch the guarded Profile acquisition and observe its actual prepared child.
cases.fault: Drop the real acquisition reply before Root receives or retains a successful child handle; use the real produced-error terminal path, fail child settlement, then restart Root.
observations: The durable pending intent survives even though no retained successful projection/Arc was returned.
Replacement production drain decrypts the original closed reference and queries the actual Profile producer.
Matching terminal native proof releases the child; no caller-supplied UUID, missing GID or expired disclosure alone acknowledges it.

cases.name: unfinished_root_and_expired_authority_remain_quarantined
cases.setup: Prepare actual protected children under a durably ACTIVE scope; separately cover an actually SEALED but unfinished scope.
cases.fault: Terminate the owned Root process before terminal root proof, wait past original wall and monotonic content limits, and restart with an empty registry.
observations: Drain neither promotes root phase nor acknowledges the child based on expiry, missing registry or process exit.
Real prepared guards remain; actual invalidating writers stay blocked and unknown work remains capacity counted.
No content authority, RootReadPermit or successful delivery result can be recreated from durable metadata.

cases.name: unreadable_or_native_unknown_intent_retains_evidence_until_real_proof
cases.setup: Use an actual terminal root and an actual pending typed child intent; first restart with its required recovery key omitted, or make the actual child owner unavailable.
cases.fault: Invoke the bounded production drain under the unavailable configuration, including after original disclosure expiry.
observations: Missing key, authenticated endpoint failure or native UNKNOWN preserves ciphertext, key ID, pending status and prepared exclusion.
No fallback to LocalPublic, arbitrary URL, generic success or forced rollback occurs.
Restore the retained key/actual endpoint and retry; only real exact native proof can settle and acknowledge the child.

cases.name: cancelled_before_child_dispatch_uses_authenticated_absence_proof
cases.setup: Record an actual valid closed pre-dispatch intent, then cancel before the child producer receives acquisition; reach terminal root via the real error path.
cases.fault: Restart Root with no successful child handle and no prepared child for that exact intent.
observations: Absence is established by the actual configured guarded producer/native adapter for the exact immutable nonce/identity, not by a missing prepared-GID query alone.
Durable intent acknowledgement follows that actual proof and remains idempotent.
Any ambiguous or unavailable absence proof remains pending and capacity counted.

cases.name: bounded_retry_and_concurrent_restart_drain_do_not_duplicate_effects
cases.setup: Use actual pending terminal-root intents within the existing 16-scope and 202-intent limits, including one temporarily unresolved first candidate and one resolvable later candidate.
cases.fault: Run bounded production drain iterations concurrently or across a second owned restart; the unresolved candidate remains genuinely unresolved.
observations: Each invocation has an explicit original system deadline and bounded candidate/work count; no database transaction is held over a remote owner call.
An unresolved first candidate does not permanently starve a later eligible candidate across retries.
Native release and acknowledgement are exact and idempotent; no deadline renewal, new content access or fabricated complete delivery receipt occurs.
Reports distinguish actual settlement from explicit owned-fixture teardown of intentionally unknown guards.

required_receipts: Exact source commit, complete source/migration/contract pins, Cargo JSON and exit code, copied executable hashes and explicit shared-target release receipt.
Owned root marker/identity, actual PostgreSQL version, old/new Root child PID and exit status, process handles and restart chronology.
Per-case exact scope/native identity hashes, phase and pending/completed counts, prepared/native status before and after the fault, actual writer outcomes and guarded RPC outcomes.
No raw bearer tokens, private references, recovery secrets, private content, credentials or database URLs in committed evidence.
Actual normal settlement counts separate from forced fixture cleanup; owned processes stopped and exact private root absent at final cleanup.
